evidence_boundary: The v7 manuscript honestly specifies a protocol and software checks, not established behavioral or accuracy gains.
The earlier timing pilot's primary gate-minus-open posterior-error contrast was unfavorable. Its results must not be replaced by later auxiliary diagnostics.
The earlier routing pilot did not establish primary utility gains. Its CPU equivalence check makes trusted-ID recipient bookkeeping a conventional baseline, not independent novelty.
The tool-input diagnostic isolates arithmetic from selected-input validity; it does not measure free-form debate, information independence or natural-task transfer.

related_work.read_scope: abstract, introduction, sections 3.3 and appendix D.2.2 excerpts
related_work.implication: External-feedback correction and damaging originally correct answers are established concerns. Include valid-input regression controls; do not label deterministic repair a novel correction framework.
Self-verification for tool selection and parameters is prior art. A real implementation comparison needs paper and code review, not a renamed generic prompt.
Peer-induced answer changes need a no-peer reconsideration counterfactual. Reduced peer adoption is not itself utility. Treat as a preprint, not evidence of acceptance.
Information asymmetry and evidence routing already appear in InfoDelphi. Full methods review is needed before claiming an evidence-routing contribution or choosing its adaptation.
Claim-chain provenance and conservative routing have related prior work. Registry identity does not prove statistical independence in real data.

next_method_requirements_before_confirma: Separate evidence identity (same measured event) from source identity (different events can have a common source). Never deduplicate all same-source content.
Preserve exposure history and receiver-specific novelty, but compare to the same canonical deterministic ledger as a strong baseline.
Do not supply ground-truth labels or oracle effectiveness weights to the proposed method. Distinguish a task-specific calculator from a scoring-only oracle.
Use actual regenerated peer outputs for natural communication; label injected verdicts separately as interventions.
Match permitted evidence, maximum calls and terminal schema; report realized tokens and time rather than asserting equal realized cost.
Include no-peer reconsideration, independent aggregation, and a single-agent union-evidence utility reference.
Freeze a ledger-by-verdict-release factorial for mechanism attribution. A combined P-minus-baseline gain alone cannot identify the cause.
Define a new held-out evaluation only after developmental choices, including prompts, are frozen. Repeated calls do not increase independent task count.
Do not enlarge model runs just to consume server balance; prioritize experiments that distinguish plausible explanations.
claim_not_yet_supported: A novel DICE algorithm that improves independence and task utility beyond strong simple baselines on natural tasks.
discussion_trigger: If progress remains confined to deterministic tool input validation or gate utility remains unsupported, discuss whether to narrow the paper to a controlled diagnostic study before further scaling or changing its headline claims.
